# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Engine sync and new APIs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 (unreleased) adds Graphite GPU backends, async pixel reads, and performance improvements. This unreleased snapshot brings Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, a new async RequestReadPixels API, several managed-code performance wins, FreeType font support on Nano Server, and a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package. Container-based test platforms (Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server) were added to the CI matrix.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream m151 stability fixes merged** — Multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes have been synced into the engine. ([#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose the Graphite (next-gen) GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, letting apps adopt Skia's modern rendering pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel reads via RequestReadPixels** — SKImage and SKSurface gain a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, allowing GPU pixel data to be read back without stalling the GPU pipeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new package integrates SkiaSharp with the Silk.NET Vulkan bindings, and Vulkan tests now run on Android and Linux CI legs. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Solution files converted to .slnx format** — All .sln solution files have been converted to the new .slnx format for better tooling compatibility. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server containers now get font rendering via FreeType, fixing a long-standing gap where text could not be rendered in that environment. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak that occurred when the raster image creation failed has been corrected. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **Container test legs added: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — The CI matrix now includes containerized test runs for Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server, improving coverage for server and container deployment scenarios. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Windows MSVC environment initialized once per native build** — The MSVC environment is now set up once per native build instead of per-step, reducing build times on Windows. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))
- **Windows SDK version pinning removed** — The default Windows SDK version pin has been lifted, allowing builds to use the SDK available in the environment. ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## Bug Fixes

- **Performance: SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — SaveTo now writes directly to the destination, eliminating an intermediate allocation and copy. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Performance: allocation-free path in GetEncodedText and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms** — GetEncodedText no longer allocates an intermediate string in the null-terminated path; the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map is pre-sized to the known count. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
